back_translation: On the first day of the twelfth month, in the twelfth year, the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

“Son of man, take up a lament concerning Pharaoh king of Egypt and say to him: You consider yourself a young lion among the nations, but you are like a monster in the seas; you thrash about in your rivers, churning the water with your feet and fouling their streams.
The Lord GOD says this: I will spread My net over you with a company of many peoples, and they will haul you up in My net.
I will abandon you on the land and hurl you into the open field. I will make all the birds of the air settle on you, and I will satisfy the beasts of all the earth with you.
I will put your flesh on the mountains and fill the valleys with your carcass.
I will drench the land with the flow of your blood, as far as the mountains, and the ravines will be filled with you.
When I extinguish you, I will cover the heavens and darken their stars; I will cover the sun with a cloud, and the moon will not give its light.
All the shining lights in the sky I will darken over you, and I will bring darkness upon your land, declares the Lord GOD.
I will trouble the hearts of many peoples when I bring news of your destruction among the nations, to lands you have not known.

I will make many peoples appalled over you, and their kings will shudder with horror because of you when I brandish My sword before them. On the day of your downfall they will all tremble every moment, each for his own life.
For the Lord GOD says this: The sword of the king of Babylon will come against you.
I will make your hordes fall by the swords of the mighty, the most ruthless of nations. They will destroy the pride of Egypt, and all her hordes will be destroyed.
I will destroy all the cattle of Egypt that are beside the abundant waters; no human foot will muddy them again, and no cattle hooves will stir them.
Then I will make their waters settle clear and make their rivers flow like oil, declares the Lord GOD.
When I make the land of Egypt a desolation, stripped of all that filled it, when I strike down all who dwell in it, then they will know that I am the LORD.
This is a lament, and they will chant it; the daughters of the nations will chant it. Over Egypt and all her hordes they will chant it, declares the Lord GOD.”
On the fifteenth day of the month, in the twelfth year, the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
“Son of man, wail for the hordes of Egypt, and send her down—both her and the daughters of the mighty nations—to the world below, with those who go down to the Pit:
Whom do you surpass in beauty? Go down and be laid with the uncircumcised!
They will fall among those slain by the sword. The sword is drawn; drag Egypt away with all her hordes.
The mighty chiefs will speak from the midst of Sheol about Egypt and her allies: ‘They have come down, they lie still with the uncircumcised, slain by the sword.’
Assyria is there with all her company; her graves are around her. All of them are slain, fallen by the sword.
Her graves are set in the deepest parts of the Pit, and her company is around her grave. All of them are slain, fallen by the sword—those who once spread terror in the land of the living.

Elam is there with all her hordes around her grave. All of them are slain, fallen by the sword—those who went down uncircumcised to the world below, who once spread their terror in the land of the living. They bear their shame with those who go down to the Pit.

They have made a bed for Elam among the slain, with all her hordes around her graves. All of them are uncircumcised, slain by the sword, because they spread their terror in the land of the living. They bear their shame with those who go down to the Pit; they are laid among the slain.
Meshech and Tubal are there with all their hordes around their graves. All of them are uncircumcised, slain by the sword, because they spread their terror in the land of the living.

They do not lie with the fallen warriors of ancient times, who went down to Sheol with their weapons of war, whose swords were placed under their heads and whose shields rested on their bones—for the terror of these mighty ones had spread through the land of the living.
But you too will be shattered and will lie among the uncircumcised, with those slain by the sword.
Edom is there, with all her kings and princes, who despite their might are laid with those slain by the sword. They lie with the uncircumcised and with those who go down to the Pit.

All the princes of the north are there, and all the Sidonians, who went down in shame with the slain, despite the terror of their might. They lie uncircumcised with those slain by the sword and bear their shame with those who go down to the Pit.
Pharaoh will see them and be comforted over all his hordes—Pharaoh and all his army, slain by the sword, declares the Lord GOD.
For I spread My terror in the land of the living, so Pharaoh and all his hordes will be laid among the uncircumcised, with those slain by the sword, declares the Lord GOD.”
